parsed.summary: The PR resolves the issue of pickling a figure with aligned labels by modifying the `Grouper` class to handle weak references during pickling. It includes a reproduction script and additional test cases.

issues.description: The patch introduces new files (`reproduce_error.py` and `test_edge_cases.py`) without updating the documentation or contributing guidelines.
